targets.approach: The roof crack is on the slope a short way above the bathroom at the Fairy Meadows camp, and it is easy to find. Mount Harrison Smith fills the skyline behind it. The crags here are short and the walk from camp is brief.
targets.descent_text: The route ends at a gear anchor on top, and the way down is a walk-off.
targets.name: Bathroom Roof Crack

targets.approach: The Phoenix is the northeast face of the Sundial massif, also called Mount Dracula. From the lake, rough ground with little elevation gain leads to a good basecamp, and the base of the wall is a further walk across the same broken terrain. The Phreenix climbs the prominent face, which several other crack-system lines also climb, some with aid, stopping at different heights.
targets.name: The Phreenix
